name: Terrebonne Parish, LA
findings: Terrebonne Parish has 238 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Terrebonne Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 11 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
